mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE CODE_HIERARCHY AS ( SELECT C.CMPNY_CD, C.MENU_ID, C.MENU_NM_CD, C.PROGRM_FILE_NM, C.UPPER_MENU_ID, C.SORT_ORD, C.USE_FL, CAST(CONCAT(LPAD(C.SORT_ORD, 5, '0'), '_', C.MENU_ID) AS CHAR(2000)) AS PATH, 1 AS TREE_LEVEL FROM CM_MENU C WHERE C.UPPER_MENU_ID = '#' AND C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} UNION ALL SELECT C.CMPNY_CD, C.MENU_ID, C.MENU_NM_CD, C.PROGRM_FILE_NM, C.UPPER_MENU_ID, C.SORT_ORD, C.USE_FL, CAST(CONCAT(CH.PATH, '>',LPAD(C.SORT_ORD, 5, '0'), '_', C.MENU_ID) AS CHAR(2000)) AS PATH, CH.TREE_LEVEL + 1 AS TREE_LEVEL FROM CM_MENU C INNER JOIN CODE_HIERARCHY CH ON C.UPPER_MENU_ID = CH.MENU_ID WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} ) SELECT CH.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd, CH.MENU_ID AS menuId, B.MESSAGE_CN AS menuNm, CH.PROGRM_FILE_NM AS progrmFileNm, CH.UPPER_MENU_ID AS upperMenuId, CH.USE_FL AS useFl, CH.SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, CH.PATH AS path, CH.TREE_LEVEL AS treeLevel FROM CODE_HIERARCHY CH INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = CH.MENU_NM_CD AND B.CMPNY_CD = CH.CMPNY_CD AND B.LANG_CODE = #{langGb} ORDER BY CH.PATH

WITH RECURSIVE CODE_HIERARCHY AS ( SELECT C.CMPNY_CD, C.MENU_ID, C.MENU_NM_CD, C.PROGRM_FILE_NM, C.UPPER_MENU_ID, C.SORT_ORD, C.USE_FL, CAST(C.MENU_ID AS CHAR(2000)) AS PATH, 1 AS TREE_LEVEL FROM CM_MENU C WHERE C.UPPER_MENU_ID = '#' AND C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND C.PROGRM_FILE_NM = 'dir' AND C.USE_FL = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT C.CMPNY_CD, C.MENU_ID, C.MENU_NM_CD, C.PROGRM_FILE_NM, C.UPPER_MENU_ID, C.SORT_ORD, C.USE_FL, CAST(CONCAT(CH.PATH, '>', C.MENU_ID) AS CHAR(5000)) AS PATH, CH.TREE_LEVEL + 1 AS TREE_LEVEL FROM CM_MENU C INNER JOIN CODE_HIERARCHY CH ON C.UPPER_MENU_ID = CH.MENU_ID AND C.CMPNY_CD = CH.CMPNY_CD WHERE C.PROGRM_FILE_NM = 'dir' AND C.USE_FL = 'Y' ) SELECT CH.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd, CH.MENU_ID AS menuId, B.MESSAGE_CN AS menuNm, CH.PROGRM_FILE_NM AS progrmFileNm, CH.UPPER_MENU_ID AS upperMenuId, CH.USE_FL AS useFl, CH.SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, CH.PATH AS path, CH.TREE_LEVEL AS treeLevel FROM CODE_HIERARCHY CH INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = CH.MENU_NM_CD AND B.CMPNY_CD = CH.CMPNY_CD AND B.LANG_CODE = #{langGb} ORDER BY CH.PATH

SELECT C.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd, C.MENU_ID AS menuId, C.MENU_NM_CD AS menuNmCd, B.MESSAGE_CN AS menuNm, C.PROGRM_FILE_NM AS progrmFileNm, C.UPPER_MENU_ID AS upperMenuId, C.SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, C.IMAGE_PATH AS imagePath, C.IMAGE_NM AS imageNm, C.USE_FL AS useFl, C.MENU_DC AS menuDc FROM CM_MENU C INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = C.MENU_NM_CD AND B.LANG_CODE = #{langGb} WHERE C.MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_MENU ( CMPNY_CD, MENU_ID, MENU_NM_CD, PROGRM_FILE_NM, UPPER_MENU_ID, SORT_ORD, MENU_DC, USE_FL, IMAGE_PATH, IMAGE_NM, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, #{menuId}, #{menuNmCd}, #{progrmFileNm}, #{upperMenuId}, #{sortOrd}, #{menuDc}, #{useFl}, #{imagePath}, #{imageNm}, #{creationId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_MENU SET MENU_NM_CD = #{menuNmCd}, PROGRM_FILE_NM = #{progrmFileNm}, UPPER_MENU_ID = #{upperMenuId}, SORT_ORD = #{sortOrd}, MENU_DC = #{menuDc}, USE_FL = #{useFl}, IMAGE_PATH = #{imagePath}, IMAGE_NM = #{imageNm}, UPDATE_ID = #{updateId}, UPDATE_DT = NOW() WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE CODE_HIERARCHY AS ( SELECT C.CMPNY_CD, C.MENU_ID, C.MENU_NM_CD, C.PROGRM_FILE_NM, C.UPPER_MENU_ID, C.SORT_ORD, C.USE_FL, CASE WHEN IMAGE_PATH IS NULL OR IMAGE_PATH = '/' OR IMAGE_PATH = '' OR IMAGE_NM IS NULL OR IMAGE_NM = '/' OR IMAGE_PATH = '' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(IMAGE_PATH, IMAGE_NM) END AS IMAGE_FULL_PATH, CAST(CONCAT(LPAD(C.SORT_ORD, 5, '0'), '_', C.MENU_ID) AS CHAR(2000)) AS PATH, 1 AS TREE_LEVEL FROM CM_MENU C WHERE C.UPPER_MENU_ID = '#' AND C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} UNION ALL SELECT C.CMPNY_CD, C.MENU_ID, C.MENU_NM_CD, C.PROGRM_FILE_NM, C.UPPER_MENU_ID, C.SORT_ORD, C.USE_FL, CASE WHEN IMAGE_PATH IS NULL OR IMAGE_PATH = '/' OR IMAGE_PATH = '' OR IMAGE_NM IS NULL OR IMAGE_NM = '/' OR IMAGE_PATH = '' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(IMAGE_PATH, IMAGE_NM) END AS IMAGE_FULL_PATH, CAST(CONCAT(CH.PATH, '>', LPAD(C.SORT_ORD, 5, '0'), '_', C.MENU_ID) AS CHAR(2000)) AS PATH, CH.TREE_LEVEL + 1 AS TREE_LEVEL FROM CM_MENU C INNER JOIN CODE_HIERARCHY CH ON C.UPPER_MENU_ID = CH.MENU_ID WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND C.USE_FL = 'Y' ), DEPT AS ( SELECT A.MBRSH_SQ, A.DEPT_CD FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A INNER JOIN CM_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' UNION SELECT C.DPRLR_ID AS MBRSH_SQ, C.DEPT_CD FROM CM_DEPT C WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND C.DPRLR_ID IN ( SELECT A.MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A INNER JOIN CM_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ) ) SELECT CH.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd, CH.MENU_ID AS menuId, B.MESSAGE_CN AS menuNm, CH.IMAGE_FULL_PATH AS imageFullPath, CH.PROGRM_FILE_NM AS progrmFileNm, C.PROGRM_URL AS progrmUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(C.PROGRM_URL), ''), CH.PROGRM_FILE_NM) AS navigateUrl, CH.UPPER_MENU_ID AS upperMenuId, CH.USE_FL AS useFl, CH.SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, CH.PATH AS path, CH.TREE_LEVEL AS treeLevel, CASE WHEN AMD.MENU_ID IS NULL OR CH.USE_FL = 'N' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS selectYn FROM CODE_HIERARCHY CH INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = CH.MENU_NM_CD AND B.CMPNY_CD = CH.CMPNY_CD AND B.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} INNER JOIN CM_PROGRM C ON C.CMPNY_CD = CH.CMPNY_CD AND C.PROGRM_FILE_NM = CH.PROGRM_FILE_NM AND C.USE_FL = 'Y' INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT AM.MENU_ID, AM.CMPNY_CD FROM CM_AUTHOR_MENU AM WHERE AM.AUTHOR_CD IN ( SELECT AUTHOR_CD FROM ( SELECT AUTHOR_CD FROM CM_AUTHOR_USER WHERE USER_TY = 'USER' AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD IN (SELECT MBRSH_SQ FROM DEPT) UNION SELECT AUTHOR_CD FROM CM_AUTHOR_USER WHERE USER_TY = 'GROUP' AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD IN ( SELECT GROUP_ID FROM CM_GROUP_USER WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USE_FL = 'Y' AND MBRSH_SQ IN (SELECT MBRSH_SQ FROM DEPT) ) UNION SELECT AUTHOR_CD FROM CM_AUTHOR_USER WHERE USER_TY = 'DEPT' AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD IN (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM DEPT) ) A ) ) AMD ON AMD.CMPNY_CD = CH.CMPNY_CD AND AMD.MENU_ID = CH.MENU_ID ORDER BY CH.PATH
